cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.
